### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are identified for the change to restore converter class names in CLI output. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #3867 by aligning CLI converter-list output with the current API response, restoring class names that previously appeared blank. **Changes:** - Reads converter class names from `identifier.class_name` instead of the obsolete `converter_type` field. - Updates the existing formatter test fixtures to match the API response shape. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​unit/​cli/​test_output.py` | Updates converter fixtures to use nested identifiers. | | `pyrit/​cli/​_output.py` | Reads and displays class names from converter identifiers. |
Review effort: Balanced
